title: Viridian Penthouse #402 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the 4,025 square-foot interior dazzles with floor-to-ceiling windows that frame the breathtaking views and fill the space with natural light. The heart of the home is the open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area, where culinary enthusiasts will delight in the ample counter space and a large pantry. Comfort meets elegance in the living area, which is decked out with plush sofas and multiple side chairs, inviting guests to relax and take in the vistas. Each bedroom, including the two master suites, is a retreat in itself, featuring king-sized beds, en suite bathrooms, and luxurious amenities to enhance the stay. With direct elevator access and exclusive beach setups, Viridian Penthouse is not just a vacation rental, but a gateway to an unforgettable coastal experience. Viridian Penthouse #402 is a vision of upscale beachfront living, designed to provide families with the pinnacle of luxury and comfort. This stunning five-bedroom penthouse boasts two master suites with sweeping views of the gulf, enhancing every stay with the soothing sounds and sights of the sea. With three additional spacious guest bedrooms, the accommodation is generously sized to host family gatherings without compromising on privacy or space. The real showstopper is the expansive outdoor living area, complete with a built-in gas grill and a dining table for ten, set against a panoramic backdrop of the coastline stretching to Destin. Here, every sunset becomes a private spectacle to cherish.

Features: Five beach cruiser bicycles are included with the stay.
